headline: GeoServer and a second Drupal core flaw join CISA KEV; unpatched Cacti zero-day has a public PoC; pCloud confirms password manager hack

bullets.text: New in KEV 11-27 (due 11-30): two exploited OSGeo GeoServer flaws, CVE-2026-120705 (XML injection) and CVE-2026-129243 (incorrect authorization). SecurityWeek reports the two newly disclosed vulnerabilities are under attack.
Drupal: CVE-2026-136716, the second core flaw reported as exploited for site takeover, was added to KEV 11-27 (due 11-30). The KEV due date for the earlier core RCE, CVE-2026-132165, passed on 11-27.
Cacti: BleepingComputer reports the zero-day giving remote code execution is still unpatched and now has a public proof of concept.

New breaches: pCloud confirmed a hack of its password manager after suspicious login alerts, with email addresses exposed. Also reported: US Air Force Cloud One platform hacked, Boston Scientific, Barclays' US arm, Japan's education ministry, and a Pacific Blue Cross service disruption.

Still developing: 1Password source code and customer data theft (7 outlets), SAP incident after suspicious GitHub activity, FIFA and Flight Centre data theft, and state hackers' use of the ARTEX AI tool. A Microsoft Store app was found delivering Vinci RAT.

SITCON eased to 4 (GUARDED) from 3: 13 KEV additions in three working days, 8 critical reports in two; last 7 days scored 1.32x the 90-day average. KEV entries from 11-25 for Mitel MiCollab, Juniper Session Smart, Xen Orchestra and Danfoss AK-SM 800A are mostly due 11-28.

actions: GeoServer: patch CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243 (KEV due 11-30), limit public exposure, and check for signs of compromise.
Drupal: apply the latest core security release covering CVE-2026-136716 as well as CVE-2026-132165, and check sites for takeover.
Cacti: no patch yet and a PoC is public. Limit who can reach the UI, review guest access, and watch for a vendor fix.
pCloud password manager users: review login alerts, follow the vendor notice, and expect phishing to exposed email addresses.
Due 11-28 in KEV: Mitel MiCollab, Juniper Session Smart CVE-2026-103406, Xen Orchestra CVE-2026-133469, Danfoss AK-SM 800A. Finish patching.
1Password and SAP customers: keep following vendor notices. Still open: vCenter CVE-2026-123890, LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217 (KEV due 12-02).
